response.sql:
WITH project_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    p.arcregistry,
    p.fundflux,
    AVG(sp.boxx) / AVG(sp.boxz) as ratio
  FROM scanspatial sp
  INNER JOIN projects p ON sp.arcref = p.arcregistry
  WHERE sp.boxx IS NOT NULL AND sp.boxz IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux
),
fundflux_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    fundflux,
    AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM project_ratios
  WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY fundflux
)
SELECT 
  pr.arcregistry,
  pr.fundflux,
  pr.ratio,
  pr.ratio - fa.avg_ratio as margin
FROM project_ratios pr
LEFT JOIN fundflux_averages fa ON 
  (pr.fundflux IS NULL AND fa.fundflux IS NULL) OR
  (pr.fundflux IS NOT NULL AND fa.fundflux IS NOT NULL AND pr.fundflux = fa.fundflux)
ORDER BY pr.ratio - fa.avg_ratio IS NULL, pr.ratio - fa.avg_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Each project's bounding-box ratio is calculated as AVG(boxx) / AVG(boxz) across all spatial records where both dimensions are non-NULL, not as the average of individual record ratios AVG(boxx / boxz).
When computing the average ratio within a funding source, spatial records with NULL ratio values (from division by zero or missing boxz) are excluded from the average.

alternatives.interpretation: Each project's ratio could be SUM(boxx) / SUM(boxz) instead of AVG(boxx) / AVG(boxz), aggregating total dimensions rather than average dimensions.
